subject: Re: Acme trial procurement & billing readiness
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lane <jordan.lane@acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-05T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Acme trial follow-up / procurement questions

Hi Jordan — great call today, thanks for walking through the demo and the initial success criteria. Quick recap and a few items we need to unblock the trial -> paid path: 

1) Procurement path: do you expect to pay by PO/net-30 or will you use a corporate card? If PO, do you have a preferred template or contact in procurement we should loop in?

2) Marketplace: you mentioned exploring AWS Marketplace — would you prefer to transact there (Marketplace listing) or directly with Redwood? Marketplace affects invoicing and timing.

3) Trial success criteria & billing start: you mentioned throughput and latency goals on the call. Can you confirm the numeric thresholds you'd consider for conversion (eg X tokens/day for Y days)? We can also propose a start date for billed usage once thresholds are met.

Next steps I propose: I will attach the SOW and a short invoice/vendor info sheet. If procurement needs W9 or vendor tax details, let me know and I’ll attach. Can we aim to have procurement input by next Thu (5/13) so we can align billing start for the week of 5/18?

Attachments: Redwood-SOW-Acme.pdf (stub)

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Lane <jordan.lane@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Date: 2026-05-06T12:10:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Acme trial follow-up / procurement questions

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap. A few answers from our side: 

- Procurement: we will almost certainly need to go via PO/net-30. I looped Priya from procurement on this thread.
- Marketplace: we prefer AWS Marketplace in general for vendors we buy repeatedly, but procurement can be faster if Redwood can accept a PO directly. Can you outline the differences in timing for Marketplace vs direct PO?
- Success criteria: on the call we discussed: 5,000 generated tokens/day sustained for 7 consecutive days AND 95th pct latency < 300ms for our sample load. If those are met we will convert the trial.

Priya — any specific vendor docs you need? W9 and vendor tax id are typical. Also please advise if Acme needs the SOW to be countersigned before we issue a PO.

On Wed, May 6, 2026 at 9:10 AM EDT Jordan Lane <jordan.lane@acme.com> wrote:

Thanks,
Jordan

Hi Marissa / Jordan — looping procurement. A couple items we need to issue a PO: 

- Signed SOW (PDF) or a short order form listing products and list price.
- Vendor legal name + address + tax ID + W9 (for US vendors).
- Invoice remit instructions and preferred payment terms (we typically request net-30).

We prefer DocuSign for signatures. If Redwood can provide the SOW and a short vendor packet (W9, remit, tax ID), we can start a PO immediately. Also please include a contact for billing questions.

Attachments: Invoice-Details.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Priya Shah

Date: 2026-05-12T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme trial follow-up / procurement questions

Thanks Priya / Jordan — attaching the requested items and summarizing next steps so everyone has a single source of truth. 

Attachments included (stubs):
- Redwood-SOW-Acme.pdf — SOW describing trial scope, success criteria, and endpoints.
- Invoice-Details.xlsx — vendor remit & billing contact.
- SOC2_summary.pdf — security/compliance doc for procurement review.

Procurement / commercial notes: 
- Vendor info: Redwood Inference, Inc. | 123 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103 | Tax ID: 12-3456789. W9 attached in invoice sheet.
- Payment terms: net-30 via PO (default) — if you prefer to transact via AWS Marketplace we can make that available but it will change invoicing cadence; we can share expected time delta separately.
- DocuSign link to countersign SOW: https://www.docusign.com/secure-sign/ABCDEF123456

Trial-to-paid conversion plan (proposed):
- Success criteria: >= 5,000 generated tokens/day sustained for 7 consecutive days AND 95th pct latency < 300ms for the test suite outlined in the SOW.
- If criteria met, billing will start on the first Monday following the 7-day success window. Target billing start (if criteria met on schedule): 2026-05-20.
- If you prefer to align to a PO start date instead, we can accept a PO with an agreed start date — we’ll defer billing until that date.

Next steps / asks: 
- Priya: please confirm vendor packet is sufficient for PO (W9 + Invoice sheet + SOW).
- Jordan: confirm the success criteria values above match what you expect from the product team.
- Connor / Vivek: can you provide a short note on expected Marketplace time delta (1-3 weeks typical) so Jordan/procurement can decide?

Happy to hop on a quick 15-min call if useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
